content: .{@-पतिः@} .²1 a householder; वामं गृहपतिं नय <ls>Rv. 6. 53. 2</ls>; a man who has entered on the second stage of life, one who, after having completed his studies, is married and settled. .²2 a sacrificer. .²3 the virtue of a householder; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} hospitality. .²4 <ab>Ved.</ab> an epithet of Agni. .²5 the maintenance of the sacred and perpetual fire. .²6 the head or judge of a village; <ls>Mk. 2</ls>; <ls>Dk. 8</ls>.
